text: Final API/module boundary audit complete. Reviewed dataset public surface, LNA JVM adapter, docs/module-relations.md, README, and direct consumers in model/fit/mvpa-dataset/group via rg. Fixed two audit findings: FmriDataset now preserves typed event-alignment errors in the throwing adapter, and DatasetEvents exposes columnEither with DatasetColumnNotFound instead of only Map.apply-style column access. Docs now match build.sbt: design depends on hrf+linalg, dataset depends on image/hrf/archive/latent/bids with bids remaining dependency-free. Production model adapter no longer consumes events.rows; remaining DatasetEvents(Vector[Map]) uses are compatibility construction sites in tests. Verification: live sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test passed (44 JVM, 31 JS); live sbt modelJVM/test and modelJS/test passed (13 each); clean HEAD overlay with only dataset/model changes passed sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test modelJVM/test modelJS/test; git diff --check over dataset/model/docs/build passed. No follow-up motes needed for this epic.
